## Introduction

This is my GitHub Advanced tutorial. I will use R and tidyverse to create a simple visualization using a built-in dataset.

## Setup

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
```

## Data Visualization

This plot shows the relationship between car weight and fuel efficiency using the built-in mtcars dataset.

```{r}
ggplot(mpg, aes(x = displ, y = hwy, color = class)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(
    title = "Engine Displacement vs. Highway MPG",
    x = "Engine Displacement (L)",
    y = "Highway MPG",
    color = "Car Class"
  )
```
